value.summary: Renamed the helpers in lib/util.mjs to double(n) and halve(n) with unchanged bodies, and kept the old names as alias exports (doubleInternal = double, halveInternal = halve) so existing imports keep working. Extended tests/util.test.mjs with assertions on the new names while keeping the original old-name assertions untouched. Ran the test suite with node --test; all tests pass, behavior is unchanged. Satisfied: new names exported and correct, old names still resolve with identical behavior, no functional change.
